tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and map background, the paper everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, menus, label plates on the map.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, the gutter between map regions. Body text on it uses ink or ink-muted, never ink-faint or accent.

tokens.name: region-a
tokens.usage: Map regions at odd nesting depth (repo, folder).

tokens.name: region-b
tokens.usage: Map regions at even nesting depth (package, file group).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers that carry no meaning. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and region outlines; at least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface, on accent-soft and on lens-1 to lens-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (timestamps, counts) on surface and surface-raised only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Braid's own marks: links Braid draws (stitches, pins, selection), the focus ring, the primary action. As text, on surface and surface-raised only.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, intent notes, the tint behind accent text or icons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: human
tokens.usage: Code written by a person. Always solid. A mark (3:1), not a text colour.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Code written by an agent. Always drawn with the diagonal hatch. A mark, not a text colour.

tokens.name: mixed
tokens.usage: Agent-written code a person then changed. Always drawn with the dot pattern. A mark, not a text colour.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: No evidence of authorship. Always drawn hollow (outline only). Never counted as human.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success states, always with a word or icon. As text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention: waiting agents, overlaps. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Conflicts, failures, broken callers. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: lens-1
tokens.usage: Lens scale, lowest step. Map labels sit on a surface-raised plate, never directly on lens fills.

tokens.name: lens-2
tokens.usage: Lens scale, step 2.

tokens.name: lens-3
tokens.usage: Lens scale, step 3.

tokens.name: lens-4
tokens.usage: Lens scale, step 4.

tokens.name: lens-5
tokens.usage: Lens scale, highest step.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The product name on covers and the first-run screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Workspace name, big numbers on dashboards.

styles.name: map-label
styles.usage: Folder and file names on the map at small zoom; always on a label plate.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Paths, SHAs, worktree names, counts in rows.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels above titles. Set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips, between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items, padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of rows and cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margins of full views.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top bar height, large separations.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, grade badges, ribbon ends, map regions.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, inputs, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating panels, the command palette, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Agent markers, status pills, the lens switcher.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating panels over the map. Borders first; shadow only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, the command palette.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, region outlines at far zoom.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Icons, connectors, unknown-authorship outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Selection, focus ring, links Braid draws (stitches, pins).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The one bar across the top of every view.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The left icon rail.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Side panels: inbox, fleet, details.

tokens.name: story-width
tokens.usage: Reading column of the change story.
